meta.scope: Saudi Arabia Batch 6 — Mega-projects densification: NEOM, Red Sea, Qiddiya and giga-project portfolio framing under Vision 2030.

candidates.title: NEOM giga-project framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from Vision 2030 and project monitoring sources
candidates.description: Framing of NEOM as the flagship Vision 2030 giga-project. Largest share of awarded contracts among the official giga-projects; intended as a new economic and urban pole on the Red Sea / northwest frontier.

candidates.title: Red Sea Global / tourism mega-project framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from Vision 2030 and project sources
candidates.description: Framing of Red Sea Global and related tourism/luxury destination projects. Core component of the Vision 2030 tourism diversification pillar along the western coast.

candidates.title: Qiddiya entertainment mega-project framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from Vision 2030 and project sources
candidates.description: Framing of Qiddiya as the principal entertainment, sports and leisure giga-project near Riyadh. Complements the capital-region densification and the Vision 2030 quality-of-life and tourism pillars.

candidates.title: Vision 2030 giga-project portfolio framing
candidates.description: System-level framing of the official and broader giga-project portfolio (NEOM, Diriyah, Qiddiya, ROSHN, Red Sea Global and related). Cumulative awarded contracts exceed USD 100 billion; execution prioritisation and capital discipline have become more selective in recent years.
referenced_by: NEOM, Red Sea and Qiddiya nodes
candidates.notes: Overall mega-project portfolio densification under Vision 2030.
